Changelog:
The location entry in the server info bar can now show a short ward and plot. Add :short to the tag, so <ward:short> shows "W14" and <plot:short> shows "P23" (or "A5" for an apartment, "P23 R3" for a room). For example, "<zone> <ward:short> <plot:short>" shows "Mist W14 P23". The full tags still work as before.

The tooltip text box now has a hint next to it reminding you that \n starts a new line.
